based_on.change: An Open Dental-native, HIPAA-covered AI receptionist for independent practices, $199/month with no contract, sold by missed-call audits.

product.name: LunchLine
product.one_liner: An AI receptionist that answers the calls a dental front desk misses and books them into Open Dental.
product.customer: Owner-dentists and office managers of independent 1-3 location US practices on Open Dental
product.problem: Practices miss 20-38% of calls, mostly at lunch and after hours, and missed new-patient calls are lost revenue.

stack.choice: Node.js 22 (stdlib HTTP server) + Retell AI voice agent + Open Dental API, hosted on AWS EC2 under the AWS BAA
stack.why: Retell handles telephony, speech and the LLM under a self-serve BAA; a small Node webhook service checks slots and writes appointments to Open Dental. No framework is needed for 3 endpoints.

components.name: Hosting with BAA
components.tool: AWS EC2 small instance, encrypted EBS, AWS BAA via Artifact

alternatives.name: Vapi + Twilio
alternatives.why_not: Vapi's HIPAA add-on is reported at $1,000-2,000/month and Twilio's BAA needs Security Edition: over budget

alternatives.name: NexHealth Synchronizer for all PMS
alternatives.why_not: Wider PMS reach, but BAAs sit on the custom Scale tier; start Open Dental-only and add it later

env.purpose: Authenticate Retell API calls and verify webhooks

env.name: OPEN_DENTAL_CUSTOMER_KEY
env.purpose: Per-clinic customer key (one clinic in the pilot)

env.name: PORT
env.purpose: HTTP port for the webhook server

structure.purpose: Scripts: start and test (node --test), no dependencies

Pure functions: find open slots in a schedule
Thin client for Open Dental appointment endpoints
Webhook endpoints Retell calls: check availability, book, hand off

personas.name: The swamped office manager
personas.role: Office manager at an independent 1-3 location practice
personas.pain: Phones ring during check-ins and lunch; callers can't get through
personas.quote: create frustrated callers who WANT to become new patients, but cannot successfully get through to make an appointment.

personas.name: The contract-burned owner
personas.role: Owner-dentist locked into phone or answering contracts
personas.pain: Long contracts and tools that don't work with Open Dental
personas.quote: not very compatible with Open Dental, always gives us issues

stories.want: to receive my missed-call audit result by email
stories.so_that: I see how many calls my office misses before I buy anything
acceptance: 40 practices are called at lunch or after 5 pm and each result is logged in tracker.csv
Each owner email names the time of the test call and its outcome

stories.want: a demo number that answers as a sample practice
stories.so_that: I hear what my patients would hear
acceptance: The demo line answers within 2 rings
5 of 5 test calls end with a correct booking request

stories.want: the AI to offer real open slots from Open Dental
stories.so_that: patients only get times we can honour
acceptance: Slots come from the clinic's Open Dental schedule, not a static list
No slot overlapping an existing appointment is ever offered in 50 test calls

stories.want: the AI to write the booked appointment into Open Dental
acceptance: A booked call creates the appointment in Open Dental with patient name and phone
95% of 100 test bookings are correct with no manual fix

stories.want: callers who ask for a person to be handed to the front desk or a call-back list
stories.so_that: no patient is stuck with a robot
acceptance: Saying 'a person' transfers during open hours
After hours, a call-back entry with the caller's number is created

stories.want: every call to play recording and AI disclosure, under a signed BAA
stories.so_that: my practice stays HIPAA and state-law compliant
acceptance: The disclosure plays in the first 10 seconds of every call
Signed BAAs with Retell and AWS are stored in the compliance folder

stories.want: to pay $199 a month and cancel by email
acceptance: Stripe charges $199 monthly with no setup fee
A cancel request by email stops the next charge within 1 business day

stories.want: a weekly summary of calls answered and booked
acceptance: The email lists calls answered, booked and handed off for the week
Numbers match the call log for 2 sample weeks

sprints.name: 7-day missed-call test
sprints.goal: Prove practices miss calls and will pay a $199 pilot
sprints.exit: 2 or more paid pilots or signed letters of intent from 5 demos

sprints.name: Compliance and real slots
sprints.goal: BAAs signed and real Open Dental slots offered
sprints.exit: 0 overlapping slots offered in 50 test calls

sprints.name: Booking and hand-off
sprints.goal: Write bookings into Open Dental and hand off to humans

sprints.name: Pilots live and billing
sprints.goal: Pilot clinics live and billed monthly
sprints.exit: 2 clinics paying $199 and under 20% call hang-up rate

dod: Every acceptance criterion is checked on a real call or the Open Dental sandbox
The README Run section works from a clean clone
No secrets or patient data in the repo; .env is ignored
A pilot clinic or prospect saw the change working

variable_cost_per_customer_month.reasoning: Fix lever L1 swaps NexHealth for Open Dental write access: 450 min x $0.12 = $54 + number $2 + Open Dental $32 + card fees $6 + 10DLC $3 = $97

cac.reasoning: Fix lever L2: missed-call audit hook lifts replies; ~$100 tools + ~10 h x $50 per customer

start_cash.reasoning: The founder's stated budget of USD 2,000
